summary: The agent provides an exceptionally strong solution with highly effective, domain-specific kinematic feature engineering for this robotic arm dataset. The modelling pipeline correctly implements a 5-fold cross-validated ensemble of tree models and a custom PyTorch ResNet, properly preventing data leakage across folds. Minor flaws include omitting basic data cleaning sanity checks, evaluating the meta-model on its own training data, and relying solely on a single evaluation metric.
